Subject: 15-min technical scout: quick alignment on AlphaOps usage spike

Hey Jamie —

Noticed a bump in calls from your project this morning (nice work getting things integrated). I wanted to offer a short 15-minute technical scout so we can:

- Confirm the traffic pattern (burst vs. steady)
- See whether autoscaling/batching settings need tuning
- Share two quick suggestions that often reduce RPU by ~20% without quality tradeoffs

Quick asks: are you open to a 15-min sync this week? I can do the following windows (PT):

- Tue 8/24 10:00–11:30
- Wed 8/25 08:30–11:30 or 15:00–17:00
- Thu 8/26 09:00–12:00

If none of those work, share a couple of slots that do and I’ll match it. If you prefer to self-book, here’s a short link: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-scout

If useful, I’ll bring a one-page mutual action plan draft to capture quick next steps.

Thanks —
Connor
Connor O'Brien
SDR, Redwood Inference

Also — quick context: we're running a daytime sandbox for a new assistant flow and traffic is concentrated around payload fan-out (lots of short queries). Looking forward to the tips.

Agenda (15 minutes):
1) Quick 2-min context from you on workload characteristics
2) Live walkthrough of recent request pattern (I may ask for a sample trace)
3) Two immediate configuration recommendations + what to expect 
4) 1–2 proposed next steps (MVP rollouts / follow-up deep dive)

Prep request: if possible, share one anonymized sample trace or a screenshot of the recent token distribution in the Console. If you’d rather not, we can iterate live.

Looking forward —
Connor
